title.narrative: Zambia - Malaria - Zambia (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Zambia, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Zambia (MOH)This program has the following goals: Establish and maintain 5 malaria-free districts in Zambia by 2016. Reduce malaria deaths to near zero and reduce all-cause child mortality by 20% by 2016. Reduce malaria incidence by 75% of the 2010 baseline by 2016. The objectives of this program are: To ensure that all prioritized operations research to generate evidence to support informed decision-making on policy and implementation of malaria programme and iCCM By 2016. To have 100% of households and persons at risk in targeted areas have access to evidence-based vector control and other preventive interventions by 2016. To have, 100% of suspected-malaria cases in all health facilities receive parasitological confirmation (microscopy or RDT) and 100% of the confirmed cases at facility and community levels receive prompt and appropriate treatment, including treatment of under-five pneumonia and diarrhoea, as detailed in national diagnosis and treatment guidelines By 2016. To improve capacity in coordination, leadership, governance and resource mobilization for effective and efficient management of the NMCP. To increase knowledge levels of malaria to 100% and improve uptake and correct use of interventions to 80% by 2016. To strengthen surveillance, M&E systems in order to ensure timely availability of quality, consistent and relevant data on Malaria control performance by 2016

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for ZMB-M-MOHP01
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Outcome indicators targets and results for ZMB-M-MOHP01
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people and/or sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for ZMB-M-MOHP01
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
VC-other 1: Proportion of structures in targeted areas that received Indoor Residual Spraying during the reporting period
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment in the community
